description:
Get one media object by ID, with caption, type, engagement counts and permalink.

Use instagram_list_media to find IDs. For a carousel, instagram_get_media_children lists the individual photos and videos inside it.

fields.description: Specific fields to request. Omit for a sensible default set: id, caption, media_type, media_product_type, media_url, permalink, thumbnail_url, timestamp, …

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_get_media
title: Get Media
